description: City or region name used in reporting.
中文说明: 城市或地区名称。

description: Building or building-cluster name used in reporting.
中文说明: 建筑或建筑群名称。

description: PV unit installed-capacity capital cost.
中文说明: 光伏单位装机投资成本。

description: Battery energy-capacity capital cost.
中文说明: 电池储能单位能量容量投资成本。

description: Battery power-conversion capital cost.
中文说明: 电池功率转换单位投资成本。

description: System average annual outage duration.
中文说明: 年平均停电持续时间。

description: System average annual interruption frequency.
中文说明: 年平均停电次数。

description: Value of lost load per unit unserved electricity equivalent.
中文说明: 单位未供电电量对应的停电损失价值。

description: Whether PV capacity is capped by usable rooftop area.
中文说明: 是否启用光伏屋顶面积上限约束。

description: Usable fraction of rooftop area for PV installation.
中文说明: 屋顶面积利用率。

description: Rooftop area available for PV installation.
中文说明: 可安装光伏的屋顶面积。

description: PV module rated power density per unit installed area.
中文说明: 单位面积光伏组件装机功率。

description: Annual PV O&M cost as a fraction of PV CAPEX.
中文说明: 光伏年度运维成本占 CAPEX 比例。

description: PV project life used for capital annualization.
中文说明: 光伏项目寿命。

description: Whether surplus PV can be exported to the grid.
中文说明: 是否允许光伏余电上网。

description: Whether PV generation is available during outage hours.
中文说明: 停电期间 PV 是否可用。

description: PV capacity window around the coarse optimum for local refinement.
中文说明: 围绕粗筛最优值的光伏容量局部细化窗口。

description: PV capacity step used in local refinement; adaptive nice step is used when omitted.
中文说明: 光伏容量局部细化步长；缺失时使用自适应整齐步长。

description: Annual battery O&M cost as a fraction of battery CAPEX.
中文说明: 电池年度运维成本占 CAPEX 比例。

description: Maximum battery charge/discharge power divided by energy capacity.
中文说明: 电池最大充放电倍率。

description: Battery round-trip efficiency.
中文说明: 电池往返效率。

description: Minimum allowed battery state of charge.
中文说明: 电池最小 SOC。

description: Maximum allowed battery state of charge.
中文说明: 电池最大 SOC。

description: Initial battery state of charge at the beginning of the simulation.
中文说明: 初始 SOC。

description: Battery state of health at end of life.
中文说明: 电池寿命终止 SOH。

description: Rated cycle life to end-of-life SOH.
中文说明: 到寿命终止的额定循环次数。

description: Annual battery calendar degradation rate.
中文说明: 电池日历衰减率。

description: Maximum replacement interval if degradation is very low.
中文说明: 最长更换周期。

description: Battery energy window around the coarse optimum for local refinement.
中文说明: 围绕粗筛最优值的储能容量局部细化窗口。

description: Battery energy step used in local refinement; adaptive nice step is used when omitted.
中文说明: 储能容量局部细化步长；缺失时使用自适应整齐步长。

description: Annual real discount rate used for annualizing PV and BESS capital costs.
中文说明: 用于光伏和储能投资年化的实际折现率。

description: Cooling coefficient of performance for converting cooling thermal load to electricity.
中文说明: 制冷系统 COP。

description: Heating coefficient of performance for converting heating thermal load to electricity.
中文说明: 供热系统 COP。

description: Random seed for outage event generation.
中文说明: 停电随机生成种子。

description: Outage event generation mode.
中文说明: 停电事件生成方式。

description: Number of years to simulate by repeating the 8760 load and PV profiles.
中文说明: 通过重复 8760 小时负荷和 PV 数据进行模拟的年数。
